text: remote-graph.test.ts flakes under parallel load: search warm-up writes runtime/ while the test removes its temp dir
description: Found 2026-11-22: 'a remote graph is read-only until its owner selects a key, then commits are pushed back' fails about 1 in 3-5 runs when other test files run in parallel (vitest src/graphs/ src/auth/discard.test.ts), never alone. Error: ENOTEMPTY rmdir .../remotes/plans/.bowman, after '[Search] Warm-up failed: ENOENT rename ...runtime/.autonomy-policy.json.tmp...'. The background search warm-up (or the autonomy-policy write it triggers) still writes into the graph while afterEach removes it. Fix: await or cancel the warm-up before teardown, or let teardown retry the removal.

status.comment: 2026-11-22: the failing removal was the test's own purge (removeSpace → registry removeFiles) racing getMeta's fire-and-forget search warm-up, which still wrote runtime/autonomy-policy.json into the space. removeFiles now uses fs.rm with maxRetries 10 / retryDelay 50, so removing a space no longer fails on ENOTEMPTY when a background write (warm-up, pull) is still filling it; that also covers the real server case. Evidence: vitest src/graphs/ + auth/discard.test.ts in parallel failed 2 of 6 and 1 of 5 runs before, 0 of 10 after; tsc clean.
